description: Store a piece of information in persistent memory. Use this when you learn something important, make a decision, discover a pattern, fix a hard bug, or want to preserve context for future sessions.

category.description: REQUIRED. Category name (top-level bucket) to file this memory under. Call the category tool with action "list" for valid names, or action "create" if nothing fits. Distinct from subcategory. An unrecognized name is still accepted and remapped to a project default, but the memory is then filed in the wrong bucket — pass a real one.

content.description: The information to remember. Be specific and include context.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key scoped to project and category. Same key/content returns the existing UUID.

importance.description: Set this deliberately on every call: 1=trivial, 5=routine, 7=significant, 8+=critical. Use 8+ for hard-won bug fixes and architecture decisions. Omit only when the work is genuinely routine (defaults to 5).

project.description: REQUIRED. Project this belongs to, lowercase kebab-case (e.g. "my-web-app", "synabun"). Use the project named in your session context — this is NOT reliably auto-detected over the HTTP transport, where every caller shares one process.

related_files.description: File paths this memory relates to.

source.description: How this was learned. user-told=user explicitly shared, self-discovered=found during work, auto-saved=session context.

source_ref.description: Local session/event identifier or source reference.

subcategory.description: Optional refinement: architecture, bug-fix, api-quirk, performance, config, deployment, etc.

name: remember
